About Me

A quick hello from the girl behind the page.

My favorite photo

Bicol University BS Computer Science Amazing 1A

Annyeong! My name is Alyanna C. Pulido but you can call me Yana, Yanixx, or Direk! Well, few people call me direk just because of my previous director role in high school but it's a cute endearment that I still live by. I am now studying as an unexpected FIRST YEAR BSCS student at my dream university— BICOL UNIVERSITY.

For 18 years, I've only dreamt of one thing, finding out my purpose. I am an outgoing, easy-go-lucky, enthusiastic person. I tend to be curious about things I spark interest in. But since then, I never know what I truly want in life. What I want to become, and certainly what to take in College. Computer Science isn't really a passion to me, it never even crossed my mind. So why am I here, right? I'd like to believe that I am here for this is a way for me to find my purpose for I live by the saying “What's meant for you will find you”, but it just simply scares me knowing that I am surrounded by passionate programmers and developers.

Why I chose to be in Technology

my-story.txt ♡ open

Once upon a dream

I was unsure, I had doubts crippling into my thoughts. I never really knew what I wanted to do that is certain to me. But my Mother did. This was her dream for me, a dream of hers that I am now writing to be fulfilled. It was really never about why I chose this, it was about a written fairytale waiting to be continued. So maybe yes, it was a random day that I wanted to pursue a technology driven program I know nothing about. Silly, right? Because why would I, a simple girl wishing to be in this place. But God knows where I'm going, and I know, I will fly.

Why this course

A sweet fairytale to be shown.

For the future

My Top 3 Goals

  1. Give the people who raised me a comfortable life.

    A little background story, I am raised by my single mother with the help of my grandparents. It is a pleasure that even though I was brought to life at her very young age of 17, she chose to nurture me and bring me into who I am today. I'd like to give them back all the things they did for me, I want them to feel and know that their hard work into raising me is all worth it. And when I become someone who's stable enough, I'd want them to sit back and just relax for I've got everything under control.

  2. Be Successful

    I won't be able to achieve my number one goal if I won't be able to achieve this one!

  3. Make my mother proud

    Being raised by a single mother taught me one thing. Being grateful. I owe my life and these endeavors to the birth giver, the one who took care of me all my life. The one who decided to keep me from the raging storms of the world and give me a world full of rainbows and butterflies.
